“I didn’t even know they said it but they’ve been trying to get that for years. I would do it,” Trump said Saturday in a phone interview on Fox News.
He also criticized card fees. “I know some people would say it’s not free enterprise,” Trump said, but he questioned how a high fee can be justified when a consumer receives the bill.
Card Balances Keep Climbing
The Federal Reserve Bank of New York reported last week that credit card balances rose $22 billion in the third quarter. That is a 1.7% increase from the second quarter.

Card debt has surpassed $1.28 trillion this year. Third-quarter balances are $52 billion higher than a year earlier. The average card interest rate was 19.71% as of Nov. 4, according to Bankrate data.

Elizabeth Warren
